topic: Metformin: kidney-function monitoring frequency by eGFR band
proposed_eligibility_en: Adult taking metformin. Frequency would depend on the most recent eGFR band.
proposed_eligibility_ar: بالغ يستخدم الميتفورمين؛ يعتمد التكرار على آخر فئة لقيمة eGFR.

timing_as_stated.text_en: eGFR above 60: monitor renal function annually; eGFR 45–60: every 3 to 6 months
timing_as_stated.locator: Google.pdf p. 3–4, Specific Patient Populations (renal impairment)

timing_as_stated.text_en: GFR 60 to 45: every 3 to 6 months; GFR below 45: every 3 months
Recheck renal function at least annually, sooner with older age, CKD, intercurrent illness or new interacting drugs
Increase eGFR monitoring to every 3 to 6 months once eGFR is below 60

conflicts_en: Below eGFR 45, S10 states every 3 months while S12 (ADA/KDIGO) states every 3 to 6 months below 60.
S02 p. 84 (the source of existing rule MED02) gives monitoring during use without a fixed interval.
why_not_executable_en: Needs an interpreted eGFR value, which VITALA does not derive from stored result text; intervals conflict between sources; no clinician approval.

proposed_eligibility_en: Long-term metformin use, especially with anaemia or peripheral neuropathy.
proposed_eligibility_ar: استخدام طويل المدى للميتفورمين، خصوصًا مع فقر الدم أو اعتلال الأعصاب الطرفية.

timing_as_stated.text_en: Prolonged use is associated with decreased vitamin B12; monitor carefully, especially with anaemia or peripheral neuropathy
timing_as_stated.locator: Google.pdf p. 4, Adverse Effects; p. 5, Monitoring

timing_as_stated.text_en: Test symptomatic patients and consider periodic assessment in higher-risk patients; no fixed interval

why_not_executable_en: No source gives an interval, so nothing can be scheduled; 'long-term' is not numerically defined. Consistent with existing draft MED01, which it would only support.
collection_notes_en: last_b12_date comes from screening records (history mapping HM16, pending review).

topic: ACE inhibitor: baseline kidney function and electrolytes before starting
proposed_eligibility_en: Adult about to start an ACE inhibitor.
proposed_eligibility_ar: بالغ على وشك بدء مثبط للإنزيم المحول.

timing_as_stated.text_en: Before initiation: BP, volume status, serum creatinine/eGFR, potassium and sodium
Typical parameters to monitor are renal function (BUN, serum creatinine) and electrolytes such as potassium; no interval given

conflicts_en: Existing draft MED03 (S02 p. 83) covers baseline tests only within the diabetes guideline context.
why_not_executable_en: VITALA records medicines already started, not planned starts; SPS is a UK source, not Saudi guidance.
collection_notes_en: last_creatinine_date and last_potassium_date come from screening records (history mappings HM17/HM18, pending review).

topic: ACE inhibitor: kidney function and potassium after starting or increasing the dose
proposed_eligibility_en: Adult who started an ACE inhibitor or had its dose increased.
proposed_eligibility_ar: بالغ بدأ مثبطًا للإنزيم المحول أو زيدت جرعته.

timing_as_stated.text_en: Usually renal function and electrolytes within 1–2 weeks; higher-risk patients may need 5–7-day checks
Reassess when creatinine rises more than 30% within four weeks of starting or escalating

conflicts_en: 1–2 weeks (SPS) and 2–4 weeks (KDIGO) disagree; S12 itself says neither interval should be imposed without clinical context.
A recorded dose change does not say whether the dose went up or down.
why_not_executable_en: Conflicting intervals, both from non-Saudi guidance; the direction of a dose change is not recorded; no clinician approval.
collection_notes_en: last_creatinine_date and last_potassium_date come from screening records (history mappings HM17/HM18, pending review).

topic: ACE inhibitor: periodic kidney function and potassium during stable treatment
proposed_eligibility_en: Adult on a stable ACE inhibitor dose; frequency would depend on the indication (heart failure versus uncomplicated hypertension).
proposed_eligibility_ar: بالغ على جرعة مستقرة من مثبط الإنزيم المحول؛ يعتمد التكرار على سبب الاستخدام.

timing_as_stated.text_en: Every 3–6 months in heart failure and annually in uncomplicated hypertension; more often with risk or illness
Patients must be regularly monitored for renal function and electrolytes; no interval given
timing_as_stated.locator: goog1.pdf p. 8, Enhancing Healthcare Team Outcomes

conflicts_en: Existing draft MED05 (S04, 2013) says periodic monitoring without a fixed interval; MED04 (S03) says at least annually in diabetes.
why_not_executable_en: VITALA does not record the indication or heart-failure status; UK source; no clinician approval.
collection_notes_en: last_creatinine_date and last_potassium_date come from screening records (history mappings HM17/HM18, pending review).

topic: ACE inhibitor: action thresholds for potassium and creatinine results
proposed_eligibility_en: Not a screening eligibility rule: it would interpret a result value.
proposed_eligibility_ar: ليست قاعدة أهلية للفحص؛ تتطلب تفسير قيمة النتيجة.

timing_as_stated.text_en: Potassium above 6.0 mmol/L requires urgent clinical action
SPS August 2026 directs potassium above 5.5 mmol/L to local guidance
If renal function starts to decline, discontinue the ACE inhibitor immediately

conflicts_en: S11 says discontinue immediately on any decline; S12/KDIGO says a small stable rise is expected and reassess above 30%.
why_not_executable_en: VITALA stores results exactly as reported and never interprets them, and medication changes are clinician decisions. Kept only as explanation material for the chatbot.
